title: Bihar BCECE 2026 Result/ Rank Card
intro: Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) has released the official notification for BCECE 2026 Admission Online Form for Engineering, Medical, Pharmacy and Agriculture streams. Online application starts from 15 April 2026 and the last date to apply online is 13 May 2026. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility, age limit, admit card date, exam date, result, counselling and full admission details here.

			❓ BCECE 2026 Admission – Frequently Asked Questions
		

		
			Q1. BCECE 2026 Online Form kab start hoga?
			BCECE 2026 ke liye online application form 15 April 2026 se shuru hoga.

			Q2. BCECE 2026 apply karne ki last date kya hai?
			BCECE 2026 Online Form bharne ki last date 13 May 2026 (11:59 PM) hai.

			Q3. BCECE 2026 fee payment ki last date kya hai?
			Online fee payment ki last date 13 May 2026 (11:59 PM) hai.

			Q4. BCECE 2026 application correction kab hoga?
			Application form me correction / editing 14 May 2026 tak ki ja sakti hai.

			Q5. BCECE 2026 Admit Card kab aayega?
			BCECE 2026 ka admit card 22 May 2026 ko jari kiya jayega.

			Q6. BCECE 2026 exam date kya hai?
			PCMB Group ki exam date 30 May 2026 hai, jabki Agriculture Group ki exam date 31 May 2026 hai.

			Q7. BCECE 2026 result kab aayega?
			BCECE 2026 ka result June 2026 me jari hone ki sambhavana hai.

			Q8. BCECE 2026 ke liye application fee kitni hai?
			PCM / PCB / CBA / PCA / MBA / MCA Group ke liye General / BC / EBC candidates ko Rs.1000/- aur SC / ST / DQ candidates ko Rs.500/- dena hoga. PCMB Group ke liye General / BC / EBC candidates ko Rs.1100/- aur SC / ST / DQ candidates ko Rs.550/- dena hoga.

			Q9. BCECE 2026 fee payment ka mode kya hai?
			Candidates examination fee ko Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / Offline Challan ke madhyam se jama kar sakte hain.

			Q10. BCECE 2026 Pharmacy Stream ke liye qualification kya hai?
			Pharmacy Stream ke liye candidate ko 10+2 / Equivalent Passed or Appeared hona chahiye, jisme Physics aur Chemistry compulsory subjects ho aur optional subject me Mathematics ya Biology ho.

			Q11. BCECE 2026 Medical Stream ke liye qualification kya hai?
			Medical Stream ke liye candidate ko 10+2 / Equivalent Passed or Appeared hona chahiye with English, Physics, Chemistry and Biology subjects.

			Q12. BCECE 2026 Agriculture Stream ke liye qualification kya hai?
			Agriculture Stream ke liye candidate ko I.Sc. / I.Sc. in Agriculture pass hona chahiye, as per college seat requirement. More details ke liye official prospectus padhein.

			Q13. BCECE 2026 Engineering Stream ke liye age limit kya hai?
			Engineering Stream ke liye minimum age aur maximum age N/A hai.

			Q14. BCECE 2026 Pharmacy Stream ke liye minimum age kya hai?
			Pharmacy Stream ke liye minimum age 17 Years hai, jo 31/12/2026 ke adhar par gini jayegi.

			Q15. BCECE 2026 Medical Stream ke liye minimum age kya hai?
			Medical Stream ke liye minimum age 17 Years hai, jo 31/12/2026 ke adhar par gini jayegi.

			Q16. BCECE 2026 Agriculture Stream ke liye minimum age kya hai?
			Agriculture Stream ke liye minimum age 16 Years hai, jo 31/08/2026 ke adhar par gini jayegi.

			Q17. BCECE 2026 ke liye official website kya hai?
			BCECE 2026 ke liye official website bceceboard.bihar.gov.in hai.

			Q18. BCECE 2026 kis board ke dwara conduct kiya jata hai?
			BCECE 2026 ka ayojan Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) ke dwara kiya jata hai.
